summary: The addendum meets the PM order and reuses the Phase 7 script, checks and decisions. One Blocker: 2 of the 6 weeks (w02 and w06) repeat a page text, and pictures.json repeats the matching row, so the unchanged script gets 2 candidates for a page and exits 1. Two Major findings and one Nit are nonblocking.

paraphrase.proposes: The addendum makes one app package for each of weeks 2 to 7. It runs the Phase 7 book-picture script on 6 weeks and writes 108 JPEGs and 6 provenance files. It writes 18 image.file lines into each week file and keeps every approval draft. It adds one test on a temporary copy of a week and drops image.file in the loops-content compare. It sends 6 hand-off folders to the PM by 2026-11-16 and puts the owner items on the 11-16 list.
paraphrase.current_system: Weeks 2 to 7 are draft packages. Their text and Thai approvals are approved; the images, audio, song, scripts and loops approvals are draft. No book cover or page of these weeks names a picture. The Phase 7 script matches pictures.json rows by week, use and text, resolves the COLOR file through the Forge manifest, writes 1600 px JPEGs and a provenance file, and adds image.file lines. The book-pictures check reads those paths. Week 1 is published and its 18 pictures are set.

blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] Addendum 2026-11-05 Overview and FR 1: the claim that the Phase 7 script "works for any week, because it matches the rows by week.meta.week" is false for w02 and w06. Rationale: w02 decodable pages 1 to 6 repeat "Nan can.", "Can I?" and "I can!"; w06 decodable pages 3 and 6 both say "Tap, tap, tap!"; content/storytime/l2/print/pictures.json holds a second week 2 row for each of the three texts (nan-can-b, can-i-b, i-can-b) and a second week 6 row (tap-tap-tap-b); set-book-pictures.ts line 51 filters by week, use and text, so each repeated page gets 2 candidates and line 52 exits 1 before any write; E2 and D3 forbid a change to the match, and the addendum gives no rule for which row to take and no rule for the file to change (script, pictures.json, or the page text); the fallback "unless a defect shows; the maker reports it then" names no decision.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] FR 6 and E7: the new test names no file path, no week and no assertion. Rationale: the blast radius says "the new test file of E7" but gives no path, and the RED and GREEN commands name only the existing __tests__/storytime-book-pictures.test.ts and __tests__/storytime-loops-content.test.ts; that existing test already covers the three failure modes on temporary copies and the success case on the shipped w01; the maker must guess the file name, the week, and the checks (18 files, 18 provenance lines, 18 file lines), and a success case on w02 or w06 fails for F1.

F3 [Major] E5 and E3: the order between the 11-16 hand-off and the later approval.images edit is not defined. Rationale: E5 requires the week file of each folder to be byte-equal to git show <sha> and sends one line to the PM, and E3 puts the words edit in a later owner task; the addendum does not say which commit the folder takes when the word arrives before 11-16, and it does not say whether a second folder or a second PM line follows the edit, so the maker must guess and the Monorepo field contract (A-42 Hand-off 1, approval) receives a draft or an approved record by chance.

F4 [Nit] Blast radius: "Any test that counts the check rows of weeks 2 to 7 changes too. The maker greps for them and lists them." leaves the changed test set to a grep and names no test. Rationale: other tests read every week (storytime-print-covers-16books.test.ts line 443, storytime-loops-content.test.ts line 264), so the maker must find the set, and the wording does not say the pattern that finds it.
